# A Right Added Later

<!-- STEP id="a-new-right" -->
## Article 21A

The list of rights can grow. **Article 21A** gives children aged 6 to 14 the right to free and compulsory education, so a child's schooling is a right and not a favour.

<!-- STEP id="act-of-2009" -->
## From Right to School

The Right to Education Act, 2009, put this right to work in schools.

**Talk about it: what changes for a child when going to school becomes a right?**
